entities.summary: Andrew Smith is an Australian former field hockey striker. He played in two games at the 2008 Beijing Games, where the Kookaburras won the bronze medal. From 2011 until 2020 he was employed as a teacher and head coach of the hockey program at Maribyrnong College. He was employed as a Physical Education teacher at the start of 2021 for Nhulunbuy Christian College in Nhulunbuy.
